descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S12 「0 / 1 边界：只有列表真的空了才出现空状态（养老院 Today 1 → 0 → 1，医院有一个病人）」 0 / 1 boundary: the empty state appears only when the list is really empty (Nursing Home Today 1 → 0 → 1, Hospital with one patient)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Empty patient list: a clear empty state with a way to add patients (scan or "+").（UAT EFS state 1；TFA-94745 state 1）
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content.（UAT EFS intro；UAT 3.4；TFA-94745 AC 2）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Standard fixture: one Hospital patient, one resident on Today's Visits

When Look at the Hospital list; in Nursing Home turn the resident's In Today off, look at Today's Visits and All Residents; turn In Today back on and look at Today's Visits

Then With one patient no empty message shows; with 0 on Today the Today view shows its empty state with a way to add while All Residents still lists the resident; back to 1, the empty message is gone without a reload

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：From U1: cp1 mustContain {hospitalPatient}, mustNotContain 'no patients'; cp2 mustContain 'no residents' and 'scan', mustNotContain {snfResident}; cp3 mustContain {snfResident}, mustNotContain 'no residents'; cp4 mustContain {snfResident}, mustNotContain 'no residents'

在哪跑：dev 单元 U22；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S12 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/EFS.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S12

Plan: unit U22 (#22, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Lists and cards, both contexts. Same legacy seed, same list screens. All four only look, open a chart, or flip In Today and flip it back. S13 (nothing entered is invented) runs first, before anything is opened. EFS S12 runs second: it turns In Today off and on and its checkpoint 4 checks the restore, so the parts after it start from a checked state. TC-01 S02 runs last, because its final tap ('tap it once more so it is back as it was') has no checkpoint after it. Runs together with TC-01/S13, TC-01/S01, TC-01/S02.
